profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Well-established IT leader and developer, with over 8 years of experience managing teams of internal and contract developers, primarily supporting Incentive Reporting, but also simultaneously supporting up to 15 applications, including mainframe and distributed systems. Motivated teams to successfully integrate incentive data from multiple systems during a multi-year merger project. The integrations of multiple systems including deposits, Salesforce, Workday, AFS vision, and Shaw. Demonstrated in-depth understanding and experience working within SDLC processes and Merger Project guidelines.

•	Supervised development and support teams.
•	Analytical thinker with experience developing plans for system conversions.
•	Advanced problem-solving skills with the ability to assimilate information quickly to solve complex, time sensitive issues.	
•	Team budgeting for contract resources
•	Strong verbal and written communications
•	In-depth understanding of mainframe technologies and distributed integrations with cloud-based solutions.
•	Supported multiple applications including Varicent, Motivator, Workday.
